title: Embedding key normalization and eviction policy for robust dedupe cache
creator: Aisha Morgan
description:
Problem: The embeddings service processes many near-duplicate requests (URL-normalized text, small formatting changes, PDF-extracted content) which causes duplicate embed generation and increased compute + latency. Current prefix caching catches some obvious duplicates but misses equivalents with trivial surface differences and has coarse eviction semantics that cause cache churn for high-cardinality tenants.

Goal: Implement a deterministic key normalization layer and a hybrid eviction policy to increase cache hit rate for semantically identical content while bounding memory usage and preserving latency SLOs. This ticket covers design, prototype, and rollout gating for the normalization + eviction changes (not the cross-tenant billing or RBAC work).

Proposal summary: 1) Normalization: canonicalize inputs using a configurable pipeline: Unicode NFKC, normalize whitespace, strip boilerplate (common headers/footers defined per tenant), lowercasing for language-agnostic routes, and optional punctuation normalization. The pipeline will be tokenization-aware for long documents: run the tokenizer used by the embedding model on normalized text and truncate at model token boundaries for prefix cache keys.

2) Content fingerprinting: derive a 128-bit stable hash over normalized tokens (not raw bytes). Use SipHash-based keyed hashing with a per-tenant salt to reduce collision risks and enable cache partitioning. Store fingerprint metadata: original length, token_count, model_version, normalization_version.

3) Chunking & shard-aware keys: For long documents, produce deterministic chunk keys by sliding-window token chunking (configurable chunk_size and overlap) so we can cache commonly-shared subdocuments rather than full-doc duplicates. Keys include chunk index to allow precise invalidation.

4) Eviction: implement a hybrid LFU/LRU with TTL and soft/ hard eviction tiers: small hot-cache (LFU) for frequently-hit short snippets, larger cold-cache (LRU) for long or one-off chunks. Enforce per-tenant caps and global memory guardrails. Add value versioning for content-change invalidation: when a new embedding is generated with model_version != stored model_version or normalization_version bumped, invalidate relevant keys asynchronously.
acceptance_criteria: Improve overall embedding cache hit rate by >= 35% on internal duplicate-heavy trace compared to baseline (week-of-2026-02-15 trace)
End-to-end 95th percentile latency for /embeddings endpoint with cache hit must remain within +10ms of current baseline when using normalization pipeline
Reranking recall on our standard bench (RR50) must degrade by <= 0.5% relative to no-cache gold run; any larger regression requires rollback
Cache eviction must prevent per-tenant memory usage from exceeding configured cap during a 24h synthetic spike test
Instrumentation: per-tenant hit/miss, chunk hit distribution, normalization version drops, collision alerts, and eviction churn metric published to dashboards
Feature gate and gradual rollout plan exist (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with automated rollback on quality/latency threshold breaches

2026-03-05 - Priya Nair (PM): Reviewed proposal; requested clear per-tenant knobs and a conservative default normalization config to avoid language-specific regressions. Also requested integration test with reranker eval set.
2026-03-07 - Diego Alvarez: Implemented chunking with overlap=16 tokens and chunk_size=512 in prototype. Added fingerprint metadata to Redis value. Benchmarks pushed to dashboard link.
2026-03-09 - SRE review (brief): Raised concern about coordinated invalidation storm when normalization_version bumps. Plan to implement staggered invalidation and background recompute queue.
